tagline: Has strong but random damage output
hype: Chaos Knight is an army unto himself. Able to summon a cavalry of clones to demolish enemy defenses, should an enemy present itself, he can rift reality to pull him and his phantasms close enough to rain brutal cudgel blows upon their head.
bio:
The veteran of countless battles on a thousand worlds, Chaos Knight hails from a far upstream plane where the fundamental laws of the universe have found sentient expression. Of all the ancient Fundamentals, he is the oldest and most tireless, endlessly searching out a being he knows only as "The Light." Long ago the Light ventured out from the progenitor realm, in defiance of the first covenant. Now Chaos Knight shifts from plane to plane, always on the hunt to extinguish the Light wherever he finds it. A thousand times he has snuffed out the source, and always he slides into another plane to continue his search anew.

Upon his steed Armageddon he rides, wading into battle with maniacal frenzy, drawing strength from the disorder of the universe. A physical manifestation of chaos itself, in times of need he calls upon other versions of himself from other planes, and together these dark horsemen ride into battle, as unstoppable as any force of nature. Only when the last Light of the world is scoured from existence will the search be ended. Where rides the Chaos Knight, death soon follows.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_chaos_bolt
abilities.title: Chaos Bolt
abilities.desc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
abilities.lore: Even Chaos Knight cannot predict this manifest of unholy energy.
notes: The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.
abilities.shard: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals Chaos Knight's full damage and has 25% item potency.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_reality_rift
abilities.title: Reality Rift
abilities.desc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for 6s.
abilities.lore: Armageddon rides between the planes, bringing Chaos Knight to his victim wherever he may hide.
notes: Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.
abilities.shard: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_chaos_strike
abilities.title: Chaos Strike
abilities.desc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal.
abilities.lore: Chaos Knight's unwieldy power bludgeons those who stand before him, crushing the thickest of armors.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_armageddon
abilities.title: Ahead, Armageddon
abilities.desc:
For each second Chaos Knight keeps moving without stopping or attacking, Armageddon gains bonus movement speed. The bonus drains away while stopping, and lost when attacking.

While at least one of Chaos Knight's phantasms is alive, Ahead, Armageddon can be activated to charge over terrain, building up to a max speed before releasing. Chaos Knight and the illusions will attack units they charge over. Can only be activated once per cast of Phantasm, and is refreshed when Phantasm is cast.
notes: Being stunned, hexed, feared, taunted or rooted during the windup cancels the charge.
Ahead, Armageddon is only available when at least 1 of Chaos Knight's illusions created with the active cast of Phantasm is alive.
Activation of Ahead, Armageddon will gather all of Chaos Knight's illusions in 1300 radius regardless of how they were created.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_phantasm
abilities.title: Phantasm
abilities.desc: Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal 60 / 80 / 100% damage, but take 350% damage. DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
abilities.lore: Drawing on his battles fought across many worlds and many times, phantasms of the Chaos Knight rise up to quell all who oppose him.
notes: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for 0.5 seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
abilities.scepter:
Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a 50% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
